balls.text: drills this very full wide of off to extra cover, and scampers to extra cover. Ripal throws it to Avesh, as the ball hurts the bowler's thumb flush on the bounce. He is down for a moment, but looks fine for now
looks to push that very full ball wide of off after going across, but gets that on to his front boot. The ball goes back to the bowler, who throws back with some intent there
pulls this short of a length ball on leg to fine leg with a swivel. Just three of the four balls of the final over so far
yorker length ball and a touch wide of off. Drilled to long-off as the bat turns in his hand since it was a low full-toss
looks to pull this slower ball on middle and off, but the ball strikes his body and trickles to the on side. Still manages a leg-bye to get Rayudu back on strike

bottom edge, and taken behind! Looks to pull this back of a length ball outside off, and Dhoni plays without any foot movement while staying deep in his crease to this 141kph ball. The ball also doesn't quite bounce as much as Dhoni would have expected, and Avesh sends back the opposition captain

slashed over point, and that is his fifty too! That was pretty full and outside off, and he opened the bat face to use that little width outside off. Lofts that beyond the man at deep point's left, and gets four more
goes across off and deep in his crease, and pulls that short of a length outside off to deep midwicket, in the gap between long-on and deep square leg
digs it back of a length just outside off at 149kph, and Dhoni pulls to long-on
very full on off, and angling in. Looks to heave that, but gets that off the inside edge behind to Pant's left
that is a lovely shot! It is short of a length and wide of off from back of the hand, as Rayudu hangs deep in his crease and reaches out for it to slash that over deep extra cover
yorker just outside off, and Rayudu can't dig that out with his attempted flash
very full on off, and hoicked to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat

gets that heave off the bottom of the bat, as he looks to swing that full ball wide of off. Pant dives to his right, but can't get a hand. Two runs down to third man, who runs to his left to stop that

full-toss, and whacked over deep square leg! Stays deep in his crease and stands across off, as the ball is a low full-toss on off which he swings away from deep in his crease. Finally the maximum for Super Kings!
skips down the track, and is beaten. Another short delivery on middle, and with scrambled seam. Rayudu goes for the pull, but the ball is too high over him, and is called wide
looks to guide that shorter ball outside off, but is beaten

misfield at deep square leg by Dhawan, and that is four! He seemed to have reacted late, with the ball ball to his left there, and him sliding at the last moment. Rayudu heaves this full ball on off, and gets that off the inside half of the bat, but gets four still
and beaten again! Goes for the heave to this short of a length outside off, but can't get bat on ball
and he misses his pull! Rabada continues bowling short and just outside off, as Dhoni seems to have played too early to that. Another dot, and the pressure building
slower delivery on a short of a length and wide of off. He makes room, and gets his loft off the toe-end of the bat to third man
backs away again, and Rabada goes short of a length on middle. Another one that takes off from the surface, as Rayudu misses his slash

full-toss on off, and lofted over the bowler's head! Rabada perhaps misses his yorker, and Rayudu hangs deep in his crease to lob that. Mid-off was inside the circle, and so had little chance to stop that
another slower ball. Much fuller on off, and heaved to the man at midwicket from deep in his crease. No timing on that.
digs it in short of a length on middle and off, and Rayudu makes room to flash at that, but is beaten by the lack of pace and the high bounce
looks to slash that good length ball on middle by making room, and gets that to deep point
goes for the pull, but the ball lands just short of deep square leg running in. That was short of a length on off at 146kph, and Dhoni was almost hurried into his shot
very full and just outside off. Driven with the full face of the bat between Dhoni and the stumps for a single to long-on
slower ball on a short of a length on off. Dhoni hops in his crease, and cuts aerially to deep point
good length ball slightly wide of off. He goes across, and lunges a drive to deep point
short of a length on middle, and angling in. Clipped to fine leg
short of a length ball outside off, and cut powerfully to deep point
slog-sweeps this full ball outside off to long-on. Still can't get one away
good stop by short third man. Nortje stretches out his right hand, and takes the ball on the bounce, as Rayudu cuts this short ball outside off
full again on middle, and nudged toward cover for a quick run
presents the full face of the bat to this full ball on off, and bags another single to deep point
short of a length on middle, and cut away to deep point from deep in his crease with the hint of turn away
nearly a yorker length ball on off, and pushed down to long-on for another single. Just three runs off that Rabada over
slower ball on a short of a length outside off. He guides that to third man after waiting for the ball to come
stays deep in his crease, as Rabada goes pretty full on off. Drives that forcefully to mid-off, and takes for a rapid run
another good length ball on off, and Dhoni opens the bat face to drive that to point
pretty full on off, and drilled to mid-off. Another dot
back of a length ball just outside off, punched to the man at cover from deep in his crease
gives the ball some air on a full length on off, as Dhoni leans into the drive to play to deep point
fuller n off, and quicker too at 100kph. Digs it out toward cover
beaten! Good bounce off a good length ball outside off, and that holds on to the pitch to surprise the batter. Very, very minimal turn away from him
full and straighter on middle and off. Dhoni opens the bat face to tap that toward cover, and sets off
pushes this full ball on off to deep point
goes with a tossed up on a full length ball on off, and Dhoni drives forward with the full face of the bat to long-off
taps this good length ball just outside off toward cover, with the ball coming into him

lofts that very nicely to beat deep point! Opens the bat face to this full delivery outside off, which is right in the slot even though with scrambled seam. He just lifts his bat and gets his arms aloft to get to the right of the man in the deep
opens the bat face to this very full ball outside off at 140kph, and slices it right to the man at point
jams this good length ball outside off, but off inside half of the bat and back to the bowler
shorter in length, and wide of off. Cut away beyond third man! Rayudu stays deep in his crease and slams that to the left of point, with the fielder at third man running to his right but in vain
beaten on the outside edge! At 137kph, and on a good length just outside off. Rayudu's feet are not going anywhere, as he looks to push at that but is beaten
good turn into the batter. Pitches on a good length on off, as Dhoni pushes it back to the bowler from leg stump while playing from deep in his crease
cover dives to his right, but misses the ball as Rayudu presents the full face of the bat to this fullish ball on off for a single to long-off
flighted ball and very full outside off, pushed to deep midwicket
shorter in length on off, and dabbed to cover
tosses it up, and goes really full on middle. Pushed to long-off, as Pant says "keep changing, keep chagning" from behind
good length ball just outside off. No turn there, and clipped to the man at midwicket
full on middle. Angling in, and driven to long on for a single
full outside off, and pushed to cover's left for a jogging run
full outside off. Driven to the left of Axar. Dives to intercept
full outside off stump. A caressed drive to deep extra cover for one
good length outside off. Rocks back and punches to deep extra cover for one
around the stumps. Full outside off, and he mistimes a drive to the bowler
full on middle. Drives inside out to long off for a single
full on off. Turning in. Dhoni stretches forward and flicks to fine leg for a couple
full outside off. Defended to cover

CSK are officially in trouble! Its the carrom ball. Full on middle. Uthappa strides forward to hammer a six over wide long on, but the shot goes right up in the air instead. Ashwin calls for the catch, and then keeps his eyes on the prize as the ball returns back to Earth after going very high up. Time out
good length on off. Turning in. Flicked to deep midwicket for one
fullish outside off. Skids through. Pushed right back to the bowler
fullish outside off. Pushed to cover's right for a single
around the stumps. Full outside off to Rayudu. Pushed to Axar's left, and he runs around to get a hand to it. The batters run across for one

soft dismissal. Full on leg stump. Moeen looks to flick it over deep midwicket for six but doesn't go through with the shot at 100% power. A half-hearted attempt, and Iyer won't drop those on the boundary line. Axar continues to make heads turn with his bowling all season
good length, on middle. Uthappa whips a flick off his pad to deep backward square leg for one
full on middle, and worked off his pads to Iyer manning the deep midwicket region. Just one though
fullish just outside off stump. Defended off the front foot to Shaw at cover point
full just outside off stump. Turning in, and flicked to wide long on
full outside off. Turning in, and Uthappa slog sweeps over midwicket. But Iyer and Hetmyer combine in the deep to stop the four around the boundary
good length around the stumps. Lands on middle and off. Tucked off his waist to square leg
fullish, on middle. Flicked off his pads to midwicket. Ashwin from over the stumps
length ball on middle. Worked off his waist to short fine leg for one. Off the pad? Umpire thinks so
another length ball angling down leg. This one pitched on middle. Moeen tries to whip it off his hips behind square, but misses
full on leg, and angling down. Moeen looks to play the paddle sweep but misses out
around the stumps. Just outside off. Length ball punched to mid on
overpitched, on leg. Clipped off his boots to midwicket, where Iyer tracks around to intercept
overpitched just outside off. Driven to cover, and they are off for a single. They take Iyer's arm on, and do so successfully
full ball angling into his pads. Looks to defend, but inside edged to short fine leg
tickled fine for four to fine leg. Offcutter, length ball, angling down leg, and Uthappa helps it along its way with a gentle tuck
slower ball, full on leg. Nudged off his waist to midwicket, off the mark
back of a length on middle, and defended off the back foot

nostalgic pull from Uthappa, but it doesn't have the timing to go for six. Short ball thumped, but mistimed in front of square to deep midwicket. It actually works in Uthappa's advantage since Hetmyer was on the boundary-line at deep square leg
good length on off. Fended off the back foot to point. Ball rolls away square

back of a length, outside off. Tries to drag an pull from way outside off. Sliced in the air, and Ashwin tracks back from midwicket for an easy catch. Both openers gone Nortje using his pace well here
fullish, just outside off but angling into him. Tapped to mid on with soft hands. Allows them to pinch the single despite Rabada's direct hit
good length ball angling in, and he pulls along the ground to midwicket
good length outside off. Sticks the bat out and runs it down to third man for one
full on his toes, and flicked to deep square leg for a single
good length on off. Defended back to the bowler
overpitched on leg stump. Nearly a yorker as Uthappa misses the flick. Hits the boot. Soft lbw appeal but not given. Probably going down leg
good length just outside off. Nudges it to third man for a walking single
caressed! A bit too full, just outside off, and he drives down the ground, past Rabada, past mid off!
good length on off and angling into middle. Fended back to Rabada off the back foot
full on middle. Slower in the air. Pushed to wide long off for a single
fullish, outside off. Tap and run to point. And Uthappa is off the mark

partnership breaker as du Plessis holes out at deep midwicket - the lone fielder in the deep on the on side. Length ball, skidding in. He looks to pull it square, but ends up hitting it in front of square instead of behind. Iyer with the diving effort in the deep
full on middle. Looks to defend with soft hands. Ball holds up slightly, and defended to the off side
full outside off. Bit of turn away. Driven to wide long off gently for one
good length on off from around the stumps. Angling in, and punched to long on for one
full on middle stump, and carefully tucked off his toes to midwicket
full and wide outside off. Reaches out and drives to the right of Axar at point
back of a length, just outside off. Stands tall, and hoicks the pull through midwicket. In total control...
full outside off. Throws his bat at this for a drive. Mistimed to cover
drilled past the diving point fielder! Length ball outside off, and he smacks it square. All he had to do was get it through the infield with the powerplay restrictions.
short and wide. Offers no shot, although the width was there for the cut. Collects the wide
back of a length on off. Bit of movement into his body. Hits him on the arm as he tries to get a hand in front of his face
length ball angling into leg. Gaikwad tries to flick it fine off his hips. Ball hits his body, and rolls away to fine leg for four more
overpitched outside off stump. Gaikwad looks to drive, but it angles away. To the keeper
slashed and slashed hard! Length ball just outside off. Gaikwad runs down the track and looks to cut over point.  But edged over the cordon instead
fullish, outside off. A crisp drive through the covers. But the fielder runs towards the boundary line and slides along the boundary to intercept
full and wide outside off. Reaches at it to drive. Moves away, past the edge to the keeper

huge appeal for leg before, and given! But Gaikwad reviews. Pitches on a fullish length on off, and is angling down. The ball strikes his front knee, as he misses his clip. No inside edge, and replays show the ball would have missed leg stump.

five wides after a very good ball! Pitches it really full and outside leg, as Gaikwad goes for the flick but the ball is too far away. Pant attempts to stop that to his left, but can't get a hand either
beaten on the inside edge first ball! Good length ball on middle and off, angling in. He goes for the poke with the full face of the bat, but the ball sneaks between bat and pad

clipped behind to fine leg, and four! Not quite in control of that shot, but who cares? Capitals win by three wickets. Hetmyer leaps to punch the air, as Rabada flicks behind a very full ball on leg after playing with a bit of a room

nabbed at cover! Axar is left frustrated. Slower ball which takes almost ages to come on a full length just outside off, and he chips that to Moeen standing closer in at cover after opening the face of the bat. Some late drama here?
swing and a miss! Good length ball outside off, and he is beaten on his heave
wide outside off, and beyond Dhoni too. Hazlewood slides to this right to stop that. Very full and wide of off, and Hetmyer lets that go
change of pace, and full and wide of off. Slashed to deep point's left, and they pocket a rapid two
heaved to deep midwicket. Very full ball on middle, and played across the line
lands between long-on and the fielder running across behind him! Another good length ball on middle, and sliced over the bowler's head with the open face of the bat
whacked away over deep square leg! Gets this one off the middle of the bat, as he swings this good length ball on leg far and wide for six. Big blow at a crucial time
short delivery on leg, and he misses his pull. Cramped for him, as the ball hits him near his stomach
pulls that good length ball on middle to fine leg
short delivery on leg, and he makes room to pull that to midwicket. Throw at the bowler's end where Hetmyer was diving, but is safe since the ball doesn't hit
another low full-toss wide of off, and he heaves that across the line to long-on
appeal for leg before, and not given! Very full ball on leg, and dipping into him as he missis his clip. The ball rolls over to short third man
slower ball and on a full length ball outside off. He dances down, and clips that to long-on as Bravo gives the chase

dropped at long-on by substitute fielder Gowtham! It was a low full-toss outside off, as Hetmyer clipped with the closed face of the bat. The ball bursts through his fingers after clipping them! Oh my!
wide again. Very full and wide of off, as he lets that go. The second wide in the over
rammed back past the bowler! That was in the slot on a full length on outside off, and he is across to loft that bang over Bravo's head
not given this time! A slower ball, and full and wide of off again. Hetmyer looks to loft away from his body, but is beaten
starts with a wide, but that looks like a harsh call. Hetmyer was really across off, and Bravo bowled very full and wide of off
good stop by Hazlewood going low to his left! Slower ball on a short of a length on middle, and pulled behind. Just a single allowed though
outside edge, as he opens the bat face to this good length ball on middle. A single down to third man
punches this full delivery just outside off to mid-off. Another dot delivery
full delivery and just outside off. There is not enough room for him to slog, as he heaves that to long-on
drives this full ball on off just past the umpire and the stumps, and plays with the closed face of the bat toward mid-off
full delivery on off, and pushed to mid-off from deep in his crease. Chahar throws at the keeper's end, but doesn't hit the stumps
bowls short and just outside off. He rocks back in his crease to cut that to long-off. Another economical over from Moeen comes to an end
half an appeal for leg before, but that full ball on middle and leg was always sliding down
good length ball on off, and punched to long-off with the full face of the bat
lofted to deep point! Opens the bat face to this good length on off, and just lifts that on a couple of bounces to the fielder's left hand
goes short and a touch wide of off. Cut away to deep point, where Hazlewood runs to his left and dives to stop that
full ball on off, and he opens the bat face to lean into the push to cover, where Bravo slides to his right to stop that

but Dhawan departs in this over anyway! Chips that to cover, and that is a soft dismissal. A little skip from Moeen at cover, and that sends back a set batter. Dhawan opens the bat face to try and slice that full delivery just outside off, but is not able to get that over the fielder
skips down to this good length ball on leg, and clips that to midwicket after making room
fuller ball on middle and leg, and punched to mid-off after playing from leg stump

appeal for caught behind, and given! Dhoni can't hide his smile after that. But Dhawan reviews. UltraEdge shows no bat or glove involved, so the decision is overturned. A bouncer from Thakur on leg stump, as the ball takes off while Dhawan goes for the pull. The ball goes over both his bat and glove, and replays show there was nothing there
good length ball on his pads, and flicked behind to fine leg aerially

crashes into his off stump after flicking his pad! Bowls it full on middle, and with a scrambled seam. Ashwin looks to flick that across the line, but is beaten, as the ball hits his back pad before hitting the woodwork behind. So the experiment to promote Ashwin doesn't work
fullish ball outside off, and he guides that to beat short third man easily to his right. Deep point chases that to his left
another good length ball on off, and punched between Moeen and the cover fielder. The latter runs behind to stop that
tosses it up pretty full outside off. Pushed back to Moeen
good length ball on off, and dabbed to point. He takes off for a single, but is sent back
bowls full on middle and leg, and he clips that to fine leg with the turn into him
good length ball on middle, and clipped to long-on after going on his back foot
another back of a length ball outside off at 100kph, and clipped to deep midwicket

finds long-on with his heave! That ball was in the slot on a full length on middle and off, and he stands on leg to play that away from his body. Gets the height with his loft, but lands that right where Chahar stood waiting. Another blow for Capitals
short delivery on middle, and flicked away to deep square leg. That was bowled at 107kph
excellent stop by Gaikwad running back from short third man! Ripal guides that fullish ball outside off to the right of slip, and pockets a couple
short ball and wide of off, cut to cover with the turn away from him
good length ball on leg, and clipped to deep square leg
slower-ball bouncer! Lands it short and just outside off at 119kph, as Ripal looks to ramp that over the keeper buts is beaten by the lack of pace and the sharp bounce
yorker length ball on off, and clipped like a low full-toss toward long-on, but Moeen intercepts again from midwicket
pulls over the man at midwicket from deep in his crease. Short of a length ball on off, and he finds the gap between long-on and deep square leg after playing from deep in his crease
short of a length ball outside leg, and he pulls away from his body with his bottom hand off. The ball rolls over toward square leg for a single
fuller ball outside off, and opens the bat face to run that to third man
back of a length outside off, and clipped behind. Moeen slides to his left after running in toward the non-striker, and stops the ball
full and quick outside off. Pushed toward cover for a rapid single
tickles that really late, and nearly off Dhoni's gloves! Good length ball outside off, and plays that fine to beat short third man
punches this good length ball outside off to the man at cover
dabs at this fullish ball outside off to point
fuller on of, and slower too. Tapped to point with the open face of the bat
short delivery on off, and pulled for four to deep midwicket from deep in his crease. The man at square leg ran to his left and dived, but doesn't get a hand.
good length, on middle. Pulled behind square to fine leg
short ball, on leg. Rides the bounce to pull to deep square leg
full on off. Punched off the back foot to long on for a single
good length just outside off stump. Nudged to point off the back foot
good length outside off stump. Defended towards cover
good length outside off stump. Taps it away from his body to the off side
full on off, and his first ball is driven to long off for a single

one shot too many? Moeen at point gobbles it up. Full on middle, and he looks to hammer another slog sweep. However, its a faster ball, and Pant has sliced it in the air. Pant's bat-change does not work
full outside leg stump. Pant backs away and taps it back to the bowler
full on off. He gets down on one knee, and clubs a slog over Jadeja to the long on boundary. du Plessis was fielding in that region, but just a spectator

stumped? Dhoni appeals, and they are going upstairs. Jadeja goes wide down the leg side in expectance that Pant would again charge. Pant can't connect, and Dhoni collects. Whips the bails off but Pant did very well to get back into the crease by getting his bat down. Smart cricket from bowler and keeper. Pant's recovery was solid too

full on middle and leg. Comes down the ground and nudged it to deep midwicket. They call for two, and Jadeja is near the stumps. Jadeja parries the throw from the deep onto the stumps, but Dhawan is safe at the non-striker's
good length on leg stump. Goes deep in his crease and nudged it to cover with the bat's open face
full on off stump, and he takes a big stride forward to defend
full on off. Skips down the ground and pushes it back to the bowler
full on off stump. Defended back to the bowler

muscles it away! Instead of letting the offie settle, Pant takes the attack to the opposition. Full outside off. He skips down the ground and hammers it over wide long on. Timing isn't a 100%, but still very well struck
full on middle. Comes forward and works it off his toes to square leg
full on middle. Presses forward to defend. Inside edge goes between his legs to short fine leg
full outside leg stump. Down on one knee to sweep. Hits the pad and rolls away to short fine leg
good length, outside leg stump. Punched to midwicket's left for a single
good length, outside off, and cut to deep backward point. Fielder at deep extra cover - Uthappa - runs around to intercept

big appeal for lbw but not given. This was a length ball around leg stump and angling towards off. Pant misses the flick, and it hits the top of his pad en route to Dhoni. Not given, and they can't review either
full on leg stump. Sweeps but finds short fine leg. Bravo with the dive
full on leg, and tapped to midwicket

taken down the leg side? Dhoni appeals, Hazlewood appeals. Not given. Length ball on leg and he wants to flick. It hits his hip, and Dhoni dives to his right to grab the ball. Dhoni is smiling, has a chat with Hazlewood... goes for the review. Is it bat or thigh? Thigh - that was wishful.
sliced and done. Length ball outside off but extra bounce gets big on Iyer. Wants to check a pull to midwicket, but he's in no position to pull it off. The ball is flayed to cover instead
good length on off stump. Runs it down to third man for a single for one
full on off. Tapped off the front foot to cover point for a single

good length on off. Taps it to the bowler's left, and they scamper across for a single. Hazlewood runs around, picks it up and throws it at the bowler's end. But not a direct hit. Otherwise Iyer was out
nearly chopped on as he inside edge the attempted cut. Length ball on middle, and off. Too close to his body for the shot
full on middle, and he drives to long on for one. 21 off the over
full on off stump, and flicked to midwicket. Bravo fields there, on the circle

around the stumps, and the result is the same. In fact, its even better! Full outside off. Dhawan just walks down the ground and then lifts a six rather nonchalantly over long off. Once again the knuckleball doesn't work out the way Chahar desired
good length on off. Angling away, and cut late between the gap at short third man!

full on leg stump. Whipped off his pads, and it has enough legs to nearly go for six! Nobody in the deep on the leg side there, so Chahar has got his line all wrong, probably since he tried to bowl the knuckleball
comes down the ground and hammers it away! Full on middle. He skips down, makes it a slot delivery, and then clubs it over long on!
full outside leg, and flicked off his hips to fine leg for a single
full on leg stump, and the drive finds cover. Only two off the over so far
raps him on the pads but there's probably too high. Good length ball outside off but jagging into the stumps. Misses the flick, hits the pad and rolls away to the off side
good length, on off. Defended away to cover point off the front foot
good length on middle. And he guides it down to short third man for a single
full on middle, and he leans into a drive. Can't beat the infield though
good length outside off and angling in. Defended off the back foot to the bowler
good length, wide outside off stump. Slaps a square drive to cover point. Packed infield
full just outside off stump. Driven down the ground, and Chahar gets behind the ball to intercept

sixth time he's dismissed Shaw as the batter can't get it over the infield. Short of a length outside off. A bit of extra bounce. Shaw wants to hit it over cover but it's a wrong choice for that length. Sliced, and Faf runs backwards from mid off to lap it up
good length, outside off. And cut behind point. Rolls away to the fielder
full on off stump. Slower ball, but Shaw picks it successfully. Drives through the line and hits it over mid on
back of a length on middle and leg. Shaw is not a tall man. Wide for height as well as line
good length outside off. Cut to point off the back foot
length ball into his pads, and flicked off his pads to deep backward square leg
pulled in front of square! Shaw stands tall and smacks this length ball over the infield.
full on middle, and flicked to midwicket off the front foot
full on middle stump, and Shaw is quick to punish it. Drives it over the bowler's head!
full outside off, and he strikes a drive to cover poin
the extra ball is punished! Full outside off. Dhawan gets forward and thumps a drive past cover's right!
full on off stump, and defended off the front foot. Soft hands. To cover
short and wide, and he plays a gentle cut along the ground. First ball rolls away to cover point
good length just outside off. Punched down the ground to the bowler
full on middle, and angling down leg stump. Shaw looks to flick behind square but misses
early wicket? Oh no! Safe. Length ball outside off. Ball doesn't bounce as much. Mistimes the pull, and it's high in the air. But just beyond midwicket
good length outside off. Shaping away. Fended off the back foot. Back to Chahar
